```{r}

lc.10 <- c(19.1,24.28,28.27)
lc.20 <- c(16.77,6,7.52)

mean.lc.10 <- mean(lc.10)
mean.lc.20 <- mean(lc.20)

sd.lc.10 <- sd(lc.10)
sd.lc.20 <- sd(lc.20)

means <- c(mean.lc.10, mean.lc.20)
sds <- c(sd.lc.10, sd.lc.20)

pos <- barplot(means,
        beside = TRUE,
        names.arg = c("10ºC", "20ºC"),
        col = c("blue", "green"),
        ylim = c(0, max(means + sds) + 5),
        ylab = "Starch Content (%)")

arrows(x0 = pos , y0 = means - sds, x1 = pos, y1 = means + sds,
       angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.1, col = "black")


wilcox.test(mean.lc.10, mean.lc.20, alternative = "greater")



`````````
